The PSNR in dB against the clean image, for Gaussian noise of sigma 20 from NumPy's default_rng with seed 7. Both images are 160 by 160 pixels. The lines image has three straight lines, 3 pixels wide. The contourlet columns use 3 levels, a threshold factor of 3 and hard thresholding, except the soft column. Wavelet is wavelet thresholding with its defaults. With the factor set to 0, the noisy lines come back with 0 changed pixels. In the figure, the wedge around 166 degrees keeps the line at about 163 degrees and little of the other two.
